title: Gaussian Approximation in Wasserstein-p: Markovian Martingale Differences and Stochastic Approximation
summary: We establish nonasymptotic Gaussian approximation bounds in higher-order Wasserstein distance $W_p$, $p\geq2$, for deterministic matrix-weighted sums of multivariate Poisson martingale differences generated by uniformly ergodic Markov chains. Under an $L^{(2+η)p}$-moment condition, $η>0$, we obtain the explicit bound $$O\left(p^3\|A\|_4^2+pd^{1/4}\|A\|_2^{1/2}\|A\|_4^2\right),$$ where $A\in\mathbb{R}^n$ collects the moment sizes of the weighted increments.
